blurb: Guests can enjoy a rotating selection of craft beers in a taproom overlooking the brewhouse and cellar. The taproom offers a unique behind-the-scenes experience and hosts events including private functions in the barrel room. Growlers are available for to-go beer, and guests can bring food or order from local restaurants.
extraNote: No cash accepted, debit/credit cards only · Taproom at the brewery
